The Events of October 1620

• The Native Uprising: Around October 18, 1620, word reached Courthope that the native Bandanese on the neighboring island of Great Banda (Lonthor) were revolting against oppressive Dutch rule.
• The Secret Mission: On October 20, Courthope rowed out under the cover of night in a small boat to cross the channel, aiming to support the native resistance and help rally the rebellion.
• The Betrayal: A Dutch spy masquerading as a deserter discovered Courthope's plans and alerted Coen. The Dutch immediately deployed an ambush party of over 50 soldiers into the channel.
• The Fatal Ambush: When the Dutch intercepted his boat, Courthope refused to surrender. He was shot in the chest during the skirmish, jumped into the sea to escape, and died while attempting to swim away
